transcript.text: what is this school lunch income form and do I have to do it? can you help

That's the Free & Reduced-Price Meal Application — the income form every district sends home at the start of the year. You don't legally have to fill it out, but it's the single highest-value form in the backpack: it decides whether your kids eat free, and in most districts it also quietly unlocks fee waivers (sports, AP/college-app fees, field trips), free or discounted after-school care, and sometimes discounted internet. Even in states where lunch is already free for everyone, districts still ask for it because their funding depends on it.

It's usually one online form, 10 minutes, one per household (not per kid).

I can find your district's exact application and fill it out for you — I just need the school name and the city/state. What school do your kids go to?
What do you need from me for this? Leonardo goes to Ohlone Elementary.

Quick thing first — there are a few Ohlone Elementary schools (Palo Alto, Hayward, Fremont). Which city/state is Leonardo's?

For the meal application itself I'll need:
- Leonardo's last name, birthdate, and grade
- Your full name, phone, email, and home address
- Any other kids/adults in the household (the form is per household)
- Household income before taxes and how often you're paid — OR, if you get CalFresh/SNAP, Medi-Cal, or CalWORKs, just that case number (it skips the income section entirely)

Give me the city and whatever of that you have handy, and I'll find your district's exact application and fill it — nothing gets submitted until you see it and say yes.
What exactly are you going to put on the form? I want to see it first.

Nothing goes on it that you haven't given me — and right now I only have Leonardo's first name, so there's nothing filled in yet.

Here's exactly what I'd put, field by field, once you give it to me:

Student section
- Student name: Leonardo [last name — need it]
- Date of birth: [need it]
- Grade: [need it]
- School: Ohlone Elementary, [city — need it]

Household section

- Case number, if you get CalFresh/Medi-Cal/CalWORKs: [optional — skips income entirely]
- Gross income + pay frequency per earner: [only if no case number]

Parent/guardian section

I never invent a value. Anything you don't give me stays blank, and when the fill is done you get a screenshot of the actual form to read before anything is submitted — your yes is what submits it.

Start me with the city (Palo Alto, Hayward, or Fremont?) and I'll pull up the real application so you can see the actual fields too.
